items.item: The page has breadcrumbs back to the suppliers list, and the header shows the supplier name untruncated, a supplier code, a status lozenge with a text label, and up to four key fields
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] with link 'Nhà cung cấp' / NCC-00142; h1 'Công ty CP Thép Việt Phát' not truncated; code 'NCC-00142' in subline; lozenge 'Đang hợp tác'; KPI strip dl with exactly four fields (Chi tiêu 12 tháng, Đơn đang mở, OTD, Chứng chỉ sắp hết hạn).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Create purchase order") with other actions such as edit or deactivate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #btnNewPO '+ Tạo đơn mua hàng' is the only filled blue button; 'Chỉnh sửa' and 'Gửi RFQ' are outlined secondary buttons; audit headerPrimaryActions=1. No deactivate action exists, but the primary/secondary hierarchy holds.

items.item: Sections (overview, contacts, purchase orders, documents, performance) are reachable through tabs or an anchor bar, with the first section loaded by default and the active one marked for assistive technology
items.evidence: div[role=tablist] with five role=tab buttons; #tab-info aria-selected=true by default, others tabindex=-1; select() toggles aria-selected and hides panels; arrow/Home/End keys and hash deep-link implemented.

items.item: Company details are shown as label–value pairs in a read-only layout, with empty values handled consistently and never shown as "N/A", and email and phone shown as links with the primary contact marked
items.evidence: Read-only dl/dt/dd pairs and no 'N/A' anywhere, contacts tab has mailto:/tel: links and 'Đầu mối chính' tag on the primary contact. But no empty-value handling is implemented (every field is filled, no placeholder/dash logic), and the company 'Điện thoại tổng đài' 028 3782 4400 is plain text, not a tel: link.

items.item: The purchase orders list shows PO number, absolute date, status and a right-aligned total with currency, uses tabular figures, and links each PO number to its record
items.evidence: renderPO(): <a href="#"> on PO number, dates via d() as dd/mm/yyyy, status badge text, td/th class 'num' (text-align:right; tabular-nums), column header 'Giá trị (₫)', summary 'Tổng … ₫'. Link target is only '#'.

items.item: Each certificate or document shows its expiry date and a status that combines colour with a text label ("Valid", "Expiring in 30 days", "Expired"), and expired or expiring items are visually surfaced first
items.evidence: certState() gives badge text 'Còn hiệu lực' / 'Còn N ngày' / 'Đã hết hạn' with colour and the expiry date is shown for certificates. But the certs array is rendered in fixed order (ISO 9001 valid first, the two expiring ones last) with no sort, and the documents list has no expiry or status at all.

items.item: Performance metrics (such as on-time delivery rate and quality or defect rate) state their measurement period and unit, and show a signed change against the previous period without relying on colour alone
items.evidence: Perf panel cards 'Giao đúng hạn 94,2%', 'Tỷ lệ lỗi chất lượng 0,6%' have units (%) but no measurement period, and the sub-lines compare to a target ('Thấp hơn mục tiêu 0,8 điểm', 'Đạt mục tiêu ≤ 1%'), not a signed change vs the previous period. Only the spend KPI shows '+12,4% so với năm trước'.

items.item: Each section has its own empty state with a useful next action (for example "Add contact", "Upload certificate") and a loading skeleton; a failed section shows an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Only #poEmpty (filter-miss with 'Xóa bộ lọc') exists. No empty state for contacts, certificates, documents or performance; no skeleton (audit loadingPlaceholders=0); no error/retry state. All data is synchronous inline arrays.

items.item: Deactivating the supplier or deleting a document asks for confirmation naming the supplier or file and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: No deactivate or delete control and no confirm dialog in markup or script; documents only have 'Tải xuống' (download). Not implemented.

notes: Audit score 82 (contrast error on breadcrumb link 4.34:1, shadows on 5 cards, uppercase tracking-wide KPI/table labels). Tells: uppercase tracking-wide on KPI dt and table headers; 'VP' initials tile for a company (non-person) in the header. Mild extras not counted: PO status badges use blue/amber/green/grey (semantic, with text), dark slate top bar with blue accent (not a sidebar). Perf tab chart is data-backed, not decorative. Biggest gaps: no loading/empty/error states and no destructive-action confirmation.
